_comment: Per-course A/B arm configuration for the Prolific study.
Arm A is the instructor-modified chatbot prompt, arm B the default.
Shreya owns the AWS prompt library. aws/aiAgentGeneration/ is only a
partial mirror of it: the Lambda reads prompt files from its own
deployment bundle (agent-logic.mjs, join(__dirname, file)), so a prompt
can be live in production without ever landing in git.
buildStudyCoursePlans.js therefore warns 'prompt X is not in
aws/aiAgentGeneration/' for those; that warning is expected and must be
cleared against the deployed bundle, not against this repo. Currently
expected for Math1 (v1b, confirmed working in production) and Math2
(v1c, pending upload -- do not launch Math2 on Prolific until Shreya
confirms it is deployed, or arm A will error: there is no fallback for
a missing prompt file, loadPromptFileContents throws).
_completionCodeComment: Course-level field read by Platform.js:1123 for the end-of-study screen.
final.py rebuilds coursePlans.json from the workbooks and does not know
about it, so the builder restores it from here. These are the real codes
from the five Prolific studies, mirrored from coursePlans.json.
